purpose: UX-22/23: require explicit execution participation and expose joining an existing organisation as a separate employee path in the existing registration form.
ownerSpecification: Прозрачная Цена — инженерное ТЗ быстрого UX-ремонта v2.0, 23.09.2026, UX-22/23 T15.
coordination: Stacked on PR #5557 exact head c0e16bae19aeb4958641763b5575e8cd3334b497. Parent registration chain #5555 → #5554 → #5539 must merge first.
requiredInvariants: Execution intent does not choose logistics or any other participation automatically; no-intent remains unselected and native required validation blocks submission until an explicit choice.
The nine existing participation values remain unchanged; employee joining an existing organisation has its own visible in-place entry control and a separate option group, never a bank subtype.
Explicit sell, buy and finance intent hints remain bounded and do not grant role, tenant or auth authority.
No new server role, endpoint or registration POST; existing idempotency and status semantics stay intact.
RU/EN/ZH browser and unit acceptance, exact-head CI and independent review required before PASS.
